name: Note Mark
description: Note Mark is a fast, minimal web-based Markdown note-taking app. Notes are kept as plain Markdown files on disk and can be shared with other users or publicly, with a CodeMirror editor, optional Vim keybindings and optional OpenID Connect login.

notes.text: There is no default account, and sign-up at /auth/signup is open to anyone. Once your accounts exist, set ENABLE_INTERNAL_SIGNUP=false in /opt/notemark_data/.env and run systemctl restart notemark.
PUBLIC_URL in /opt/notemark_data/.env must be the address you open Note Mark at. Change it for a new IP or a reverse proxy, then restart notemark. Clipboard copy and the PWA need HTTPS.
